        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, self.SMA_PERIOD, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)
        self.SetWarmUp(self.SMA_PERIOD, Resolution.Daily)

        # Strategy A (SPY) private lot state
        self.a_shares = 0
        self.prev_spy_close = None
        self.prev_spy_sma = None

        # Strategy B (AAPL) private lot state
        self.b_shares = 0
        self.prev_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        for symbol in self.all_symbols:
            if symbol not in data.Bars:
                return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        if self.prev_aapl_close is not None:
            if aapl_close < self.prev_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        cross_above = False
        cross_below = False
        if self.prev_spy_close is not None and self.prev_spy_sma is not None and self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            sma_now = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

                if shares > 0:
